mutations.name: declared anchors are ignored
kills: buildOccupancy over the synthetic marks places a custom layer on the anchors it declares, alongside its DOM elements
occupancyForMark prefers declared anchors to the pixel grid

mutations.name: an undeclared custom layer with DOM labels skips the pixel fallback
kills: occupancyForMark reads pixels for an undeclared custom layer even when it has DOM labels

mutations.name: a cell exactly at the pixel threshold reads empty
kills: pixelAnchors counts a cell at the threshold as drawn on, and one below it as empty

mutations.name: an element is listed twice in one cell
kills: occupancyForMark lists an element once per cell even when two of its boxes land there

mutations.name: pixel grids match by beat only
kills: buildOccupancy's pixel lookup uses the pixel grid of the same beat at the same moment

mutations.name: pixel grids match by time only
kills: buildOccupancy's pixel lookup uses the pixel grid of the same beat at the same moment
